vb_textbox.text: Hello fellow participant! My advise on how to tackle this is simple.. keep focused on the screen, have your fingers on the 2 letters and decide quickly what letter you are going with and press it.  I found alternating between the 2 gnomes bore me more mushrooms so may be worth trying that.  With regards to the basket hit space as soon as it appears.  The game is rather boring so keep focused!
